points.K21: 个人防护：最后一道屏障
points.S1: 管理控制：制度、培训、审批
points.S5: 校园施工区：隔离与绕行
points.S6: 实验室改造维修：审批与交底

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着安全帽站在问答台后，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears a hard hat, stands behind a quiz podium and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 安全知识问答，今天讲施工篇！
overlay: 安全知识问答：施工现场与风险评估

shots.scene: 四个图标：问号、脚手架、风险矩阵、铁锹
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a question mark, a scaffold, a colored grid and a shovel. No people.
shots.narration: 从基础概念，到风险评估和施工现场。

shots.scene: 实验楼旁围起了施工围挡，阿杰想抄近路穿过去
shots.prompt_en: Next to a lab building a construction area is fenced off; the young male student is about to slip through a gap in the fence as a shortcut.
shots.narration: 实验楼旁在施工，阿杰想抄近路。

shots.scene: 老李在围挡边拦住阿杰，指向绕行通道
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stops the young male student at the fence and points to a marked detour path.
shots.narration: 老李拦住他：施工区的危险，你看不见。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起问号牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank card with a question mark icon.
shots.narration: 施工现场有哪些危险？我们一题题来。

shots.scene: 人、建筑、树三个图标外罩一层盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A person icon, a building icon and a tree icon under one protective shield. No people.
shots.narration: 安全，就是人、环境、财产都不受伤害。

shots.scene: 锐利的金属边、没有护栏的平台、湿滑地面三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons each with a yellow warning triangle: a sharp metal edge, a high platform without railings and a wet floor. No people.
shots.narration: 危害，是可能造成伤害的东西或状况。

shots.scene: 小研指着实验室地上的一滩水
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at a puddle of water on the lab floor.
shots.narration: 实验室地上的一滩水，也是危害。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在湿滑地面图标旁，手里拿着骰子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a wet floor icon and holds a big dice.
shots.narration: 风险，是被危害伤到的可能性。

shots.scene: 扭伤的脚踝图标和贴创可贴的手图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a sprained ankle with a wrap and an icon of a hand with a bandage. No people.
shots.narration: 伤害，是事故落在身体上的结果。

shots.scene: 倒下的梯子、损坏的设备、倒地的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a fallen ladder, a damaged machine and a fallen person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 事故，是不希望发生的意外。

shots.scene: 财产、环境、人三个图标打红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A building icon, a tree icon and a person icon each with a red exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 可能造成损失，甚至人员死亡。

shots.scene: 工具从高处落下，落在离小人一步远的地上
shots.prompt_en: A wrench falls from a high shelf and lands one step away from a person pictogram that is unharmed. No people.
shots.narration: 未遂事件：没伤到人，但差一点。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起食指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one finger with a serious face.
shots.narration: 它有造成伤害的可能，要当真。

shots.scene: 施工现场俯视示意，各处浮现警示图标
shots.prompt_en: A top-down cartoon of a construction site behind a fence, with small warning icons popping up over a truck, a pit, a scaffold and a cable. No people.
shots.narration: 施工现场，危害有很多种。

shots.scene: 土方坍塌、结构倒塌、石棉、电气四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four warning icons: a collapsing soil pile, a collapsing wall, a dusty fiber material and an electric shock symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 还有坍塌、有害粉尘和触电。

shots.scene: 高处平台边缘和一把卷尺图标
shots.prompt_en: A high work platform edge with a measuring tape icon hanging down to the ground. No people.
shots.narration: 在一定高度以上作业，就是高处作业。

shots.scene: 王老师指着空白标准文本
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank standard booklet.
shots.narration: 高度界限，国内按高处作业标准执行。

shots.scene: 建筑外搭着的脚手架，平台上有材料和工具图标
shots.prompt_en: A metal scaffold against a building wall, with floating icons of a person, building materials and tools above its platform. No people.
shots.narration: 脚手架，是支撑人和材料的临时平台。

shots.scene: 带轮子的移动式脚手架和落地固定式脚手架
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a mobile scaffold tower on wheels and a fixed frame scaffold standing on base plates. No people.
shots.narration: 脚手架分移动式和固定式。

shots.scene: 悬挑式、悬挂式、满堂式三个脚手架图标
shots.prompt_en: Three scaffold icons: a cantilever scaffold sticking out from a wall, a hanging platform on ropes and a large box-shaped birdcage scaffold. No people.
shots.narration: 固定式又有悬挑、悬挂、满堂等形式。

shots.scene: 开裂的钢管和歪斜在松土上的脚手架
shots.prompt_en: A cracked steel tube icon and a scaffold leaning on soft uneven ground. No people.
shots.narration: 构件损坏、地面松软不平，都危险。

shots.scene: 缺少斜撑和拉结的脚手架摇晃
shots.prompt_en: A scaffold without braces or wall ties wobbling, with motion lines. No people.
shots.narration: 拉结和斜撑不到位，架子会晃会倒。

shots.scene: 人员坠落、物料坠落、护栏缺失、通道缺失四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four warning icons: a falling person, a falling tool, a missing guardrail and a missing ladder. No people.
shots.narration: 还有坠落、护栏不全、上下不便。

shots.section_title: 脚手架搭设的安全措施（了解）
shots.scene: 持证人员图标和合格材料图标
shots.prompt_en: A person icon with a certificate badge next to a stack of standard steel tubes with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 搭设人员要有资格，材料要合格。
overlay: 脚手架搭设的安全措施（了解）

shots.section_title: 脚手架搭设的安全措施（了解）
shots.scene: 平整地面上的底座和斜撑
shots.prompt_en: A scaffold on level firm ground with base plates, diagonal braces and ties to the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 地面平整坚实，按要求拉结和设斜撑。

shots.section_title: 脚手架搭设的安全措施（了解）
shots.scene: 护栏上横杆、中横杆、挡脚板依次高亮
shots.prompt_en: On a scaffold platform the top rail, mid rail and toe board light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 护栏、挡脚板、底座，一样不能少。

shots.scene: 脚手架线图，各构件依次高亮
shots.prompt_en: A simple line drawing of a scaffold with parts highlighted one by one: sole board, base plate, upright tube, ledger, brace, coupler and plank. No people.
shots.narration: 脚手架由立杆、横杆、扣件等组成。

shots.scene: 脚手板、挡脚板、上横杆、中横杆高亮
shots.prompt_en: The scaffold plank, toe board, top rail and mid rail light up on the drawing. No people.
shots.narration: 上面铺脚手板，四周装护栏和挡脚板。

shots.scene: 护栏侧视图，上横杆旁有高度箭头
shots.prompt_en: A side view of a guardrail with a vertical height arrow beside the top rail. No people.
shots.narration: 护栏上横杆的高度，有规定范围。

shots.scene: 太矮的护栏图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A guardrail that only reaches knee height on a person pictogram, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 太低挡不住人，具体按国内规范。

shots.scene: 靠墙的直梯，与地面夹角处有角度弧线
shots.prompt_en: A straight ladder leaning against a wall with an angle arc drawn at its foot. No people.
shots.narration: 梯子靠墙，要有合适的倾斜角度。

shots.scene: 太陡和太平的梯子图标都被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two ladder icons, one almost vertical and one almost flat, both crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 太陡会后翻，太平会滑脱。

shots.scene: 梯子顶端伸出上方平台一截，有扶手图标
shots.prompt_en: A ladder whose top extends above the edge of an upper landing, with a hand icon gripping the extended part. No people.
shots.narration: 梯子要伸出平台一段，方便扶握上下。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔分五层，从上到下由绿到红
shots.prompt_en: An inverted pyramid in five colored layers from green at the top to red at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 控制风险，有五个层级。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着金字塔最上层
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the top layer of the inverted pyramid.
shots.narration: 越靠上越有效，优先从上往下选。

shots.scene: 高处的吊扇叶片坏了，旁边搭着平台，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a ceiling fan with a broken blade and a person pictogram on a tall platform beside it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 高处的风扇坏了，要爬上去修吗？

shots.scene: 老李把风扇拆下放在地面工作台上更换叶片
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer replaces the blade of a ceiling fan laid on a workbench at ground level.
shots.narration: 拆到地面修，坠落风险就没了。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs-up.
shots.narration: 直接去掉危害，是最有效的办法。

shots.scene: 受限空间入口和一盏亮着的灯，旁边有可燃气体图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a confined space entrance with a work lamp inside and a flammable gas pictogram beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 受限空间可能有可燃气体，照明有风险。

shots.scene: 普通灯具被替换成低电压灯具，火花图标消失
shots.prompt_en: A regular lamp icon with a spark is swapped for a low-voltage lamp icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 换用安全电压灯具，减少打火。

shots.scene: 小研把一瓶试剂换成另一瓶低危害试剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student swaps a bottle with a skull pictogram for a bottle with a milder warning pictogram on the lab shelf.
shots.narration: 实验室里，用低毒试剂替代高毒的。

shots.scene: 转动的皮带轮外装上防护罩
shots.prompt_en: A rotating belt and pulley icon gets a protective cover placed over it. No people.
shots.narration: 工程控制：用防护罩把转动部件隔开。

shots.scene: 急停按钮图标和自动停机图标
shots.prompt_en: A red emergency stop button icon and an automatic stop sensor icon on a machine. No people.
shots.narration: 还可以加装急停和自动停机装置。

shots.scene: 小研在通风柜里操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works inside a fume hood with the sash lowered.
shots.narration: 实验室的通风柜，也是工程控制。

shots.section_title: 个人防护：最后一道屏障
shots.scene: 阿杰戴护目镜、手套，穿实验服
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on safety goggles, gloves and a lab coat.
shots.narration: 个人防护，是前面措施之后的最后一层。
overlay: 个人防护：最后一道屏障

shots.section_title: 个人防护：最后一道屏障
shots.scene: 人和危险源图标之间有一道薄墙
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram and a hazard icon with a thin barrier wall between them; the hazard icon is still there. No people.
shots.narration: 它不能消除危害，只是隔开一层。

shots.scene: 小研和王老师在空白评估表前讨论
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the safety administrator discuss a blank assessment form on a clipboard.
shots.narration: 危害辨识与风险评估，是正式的流程。

shots.scene: 放大镜扫过实验台，危害图标逐一出现
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass moves across a lab bench and warning icons appear over a hot plate, a glass bottle and a cable. No people.
shots.narration: 先把作业中的危害一一找出来。

shots.scene: 骰子图标乘以伤害图标
shots.prompt_en: An equation of icons: a dice icon times an injury icon equals a gauge icon. No people.
shots.narration: 风险等于可能性乘以严重度。

shots.scene: 骰子图标和冲击波图标分别解释
shots.prompt_en: A dice icon labeled with a percentage symbol and a burst icon with growing rings. No people.
shots.narration: 可能性看多常发生，严重度看后果多重。

shots.scene: 五乘五的彩色方格矩阵
shots.prompt_en: A five by five colored grid, green in one corner, yellow in the middle and red in the opposite corner. No people.
shots.narration: 风险矩阵，帮我们定出风险等级。

shots.scene: 绿色方格旁打勾
shots.prompt_en: The green squares of the grid glow with a green check mark beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 低风险可以接受，也看看能否再降低。

shots.scene: 黄色方格旁有监督人员图标
shots.prompt_en: The yellow squares glow with a supervisor icon beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 中风险，要有措施和监督才能做。

shots.scene: 红色方格旁有停止手势
shots.prompt_en: The red squares glow with a stop hand icon beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 高风险不可接受，降下来之前不能做。

shots.scene: 两座脚手架：高的有护栏，矮的没护栏
shots.prompt_en: Two scaffold icons: a tall one with guardrails and a short one without guardrails. No people.
shots.narration: 来算一算：两座脚手架，哪个风险高？

shots.scene: 高脚手架旁：骰子小、冲击大，指向黄格
shots.prompt_en: Beside the tall guarded scaffold: a small dice icon, a big burst icon and an arrow pointing to a yellow square. No people.
shots.narration: 高的有护栏：不易掉，但掉下来后果重。

shots.scene: 矮脚手架旁：骰子大、冲击中，指向红格
shots.prompt_en: Beside the short unguarded scaffold: a big dice icon, a medium burst icon and an arrow pointing to a red square. No people.
shots.narration: 矮的没护栏：很容易掉，结果更危险。

shots.scene: 欣欣对比两个结果点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot looks at the two results and nods thoughtfully.
shots.narration: 风险高低，要看具体地点和条件。

shots.scene: 空白表格，表头各栏依次出现图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank table whose column headers appear one by one as icons: a number, a warning triangle, an injury, a shield, a gauge, a wrench, a gauge and a person. No people.
shots.narration: 风险评估表，各栏要填清楚。

shots.scene: 第一行：无护栏图标、坠落图标、培训图标、红色格
shots.prompt_en: The first row fills in with icons: an unguarded platform, a falling person, a training class and a red square. No people.
shots.narration: 无护栏会坠落；只做了培训，仍是高风险。

shots.scene: 护栏图标加入，红格变成绿格
shots.prompt_en: A guardrail icon is added in the next column and the red square turns into a green square. No people.
shots.narration: 加装护栏后，可能性降下来，变成低风险。

shots.scene: 最后一栏出现老李的头像图标
shots.prompt_en: The last column shows a small portrait icon of the facility engineer with a check mark.
shots.narration: 最后写明由谁负责落实。

shots.scene: 地面上挖出的土坑，旁边有铁锹和挖掘机图标
shots.prompt_en: A pit dug in the ground with a pile of soil, a shovel icon and a small excavator icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 挖掘，是从地面取土形成的坑或槽。

shots.scene: 铁锹图标和挖掘机图标并排
shots.prompt_en: A shovel icon and an excavator icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 分人工挖掘和机械挖掘两种。

shots.scene: 坑壁坍塌、人坠坑、坑内积水三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three warning icons: a pit wall collapsing, a person pictogram falling into a pit and water filling a pit. No people.
shots.narration: 坑壁可能塌，人可能掉，坑里会积水。

shots.scene: 地下电缆和管道剖面，坑边有车辆图标
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of the ground showing buried cables and pipes, with a truck icon driving close to the pit edge. No people.
shots.narration: 还怕挖断地下管线、坑边车辆和没有通道。

shots.scene: 支护、台阶、放坡三种坑壁示意图
shots.prompt_en: Three simple cross-section icons of pit walls: supported by boards, cut into steps, and sloped back. No people.
shots.narration: 用支护、台阶或放坡，防止坍塌。

shots.scene: 坑四周围挡并挂着警示标志，水泵在抽水
shots.prompt_en: A pit surrounded by a barrier fence with a warning sign, and a water pump hose drawing water out. No people.
shots.narration: 四周围挡挂警示，积水及时抽走。

shots.scene: 探测仪扫过地面，旁边是空白许可单
shots.prompt_en: A cable locator device scanning the ground above buried lines, next to a blank permit form with a stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 开挖前查清管线，办好动土审批。

shots.scene: 车辆图标在坑边停止线外
shots.prompt_en: A truck icon stops behind a painted line well away from the pit edge. No people.
shots.narration: 车辆和重物，远离坑边。

shots.scene: 窄而深的沟槽剖面，深度箭头比宽度箭头长
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section of a narrow deep trench, with the depth arrow longer than the width arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 沟槽，是深度大于宽度的窄长挖掘。

shots.scene: 全身式安全带挂在安全绳上的示意图标
shots.prompt_en: A full-body harness icon hanging from a lifeline after a fall arrest, with a clock icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 坠落被安全带挂住后，也不能久挂。

shots.scene: 腿带勒紧、下肢血流受阻的示意
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of leg straps squeezing the thighs, with blood flow arrows in the legs fading. No people.
shots.narration: 腿带勒住血管，久挂会造成严重伤害。

shots.scene: 救援人员图标和时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A rescue team icon rushing toward a hanging harness icon, with a clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 高处作业，要有及时救援的预案。

shots.scene: 安全带侧面挂着一个小袋，展开成一个脚踏环
shots.prompt_en: A small pouch on the side of a harness unfolds into a foot loop strap. No people.
shots.narration: 缓解带：悬挂时展开，踩住它。

shots.scene: 脚踩在环里，腿部血流箭头恢复
shots.prompt_en: A boot steps into the foot loop and the blood flow arrows in the leg return. No people.
shots.narration: 减轻腿部受压，坚持到救援到来。

shots.scene: 五瓣圆环图标
shots.prompt_en: A ring divided into five colored segments with simple icons: a box, a shelf, a broom, a checklist and a heart. No people.
shots.narration: 最后一题：5S现场管理。

shots.scene: 阿杰把用不着的东西清出实验台
shots.prompt_en: The young male student clears unneeded items off his lab bench into a box.
shots.narration: 整理：不需要的东西清出去。

shots.scene: 小研把工具挂回定位板，然后擦桌面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hangs tools back on an outlined pegboard and wipes the bench.
shots.narration: 整顿归位，清扫干净。

shots.scene: 墙上空白标准卡和培训图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank standard card on the wall next to a training class icon. No people.
shots.narration: 定好标准，靠意识和培训长期坚持。

shots.section_title: 管理控制：制度、培训、审批
shots.scene: 倒金字塔第四层高亮
shots.prompt_en: The fourth layer of the inverted pyramid lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 管理控制，原片没细讲，这里补上。
overlay: 管理控制：制度、培训、审批

shots.section_title: 管理控制：制度、培训、审批
shots.scene: 空白制度文件夹、培训课、审批单三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a blank rule binder, a training class and a blank approval form with a stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 定制度、做培训、危险作业先审批。

shots.section_title: 管理控制：制度、培训、审批
shots.scene: 王老师在实验室门口张贴警示标志
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator posts a warning sign beside a laboratory door.
shots.narration: 设警示标志，安排好人员和时间。

shots.scene: 阿杰弯腰硬搬重箱子，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person bending at the waist to lift a heavy box, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 搬重物，别弯腰硬拽。

shots.scene: 阿杰屈膝、贴近身体搬起一只空箱
shots.prompt_en: The young male student squats down, keeps a box close to his body and lifts with straight back.
shots.narration: 屈膝、贴身、腰背挺直。

shots.scene: 小研用手推车运送几箱试剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student moves several boxes on a lab trolley.
shots.narration: 太重太大，用推车或请人帮忙。

shots.scene: 超声波清洗器和空压机旁有声波图标
shots.prompt_en: An ultrasonic cleaner and an air compressor in a lab with sound wave icons around them. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里也有噪声大的设备。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴上耳罩
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on earmuffs before starting a loud machine.
shots.narration: 长时间在旁边，戴耳塞或耳罩。

shots.scene: 设备罩上隔音罩，人员离开
shots.prompt_en: A noisy machine gets a sound-dampening cover and the door to its room closes. No people.
shots.narration: 能加隔音罩、关门隔开更好。

shots.scene: 地上一滩水和横穿过道的电线，各带警示
shots.prompt_en: A puddle of water and a power cable stretched across a walkway, each with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 滑倒绊倒，是最常见的伤害之一。

shots.scene: 小研立起小心地滑牌，拿拖把擦干
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places a wet floor sign and mops up a puddle.
shots.narration: 洒了水和试剂，马上清理并提示。

shots.scene: 电线沿墙边用线槽收好，过道空出
shots.prompt_en: Cables neatly run along the wall in a cable cover and the walkway is clear. No people.
shots.narration: 电线走线槽，过道保持畅通。

shots.section_title: 校园施工区：隔离与绕行
shots.scene: 校园施工围挡和警示标志，旁边有绕行箭头
shots.prompt_en: A campus construction fence with a construction warning sign and a detour arrow on the path. No people.
shots.narration: 校园施工区，围挡里面不要进。
overlay: 校园施工区：隔离与绕行

shots.section_title: 校园施工区：隔离与绕行
shots.scene: 阿杰沿着绕行通道走过
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks along the marked detour path next to the fence.
shots.narration: 按标志绕行，远离吊装和车辆。

shots.section_title: 校园施工区：隔离与绕行
shots.scene: 保卫处值班员在围挡缺口前设置路障
shots.prompt_en: The security officer places a barrier at a gap in the construction fence.
shots.narration: 发现围挡破损，告诉保卫处。

shots.section_title: 实验室改造维修：审批与交底
shots.scene: 实验室门口老李和施工人员图标，老周拿着空白审批单
shots.prompt_en: At the laboratory door the older man holds a blank approval form while the facility engineer waits with a toolbox.
shots.narration: 实验室改造维修，要先办审批。
overlay: 实验室改造维修：审批与交底

shots.section_title: 实验室改造维修：审批与交底
shots.scene: 动火、临时用电、受限空间三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a welding spark, a temporary power cable reel and a confined space entrance. No people.
shots.narration: 动火、临时用电、进受限空间，都要审批。

shots.section_title: 实验室改造维修：审批与交底
shots.scene: 小研把化学品和气瓶移出作业区
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student moves chemical bottles and a gas cylinder out of the work area into a storage cabinet.
shots.narration: 施工前移走化学品，关好气源。

shots.section_title: 实验室改造维修：审批与交底
shots.scene: 老周向老李交代实验室危险点
shots.prompt_en: The older man points out hazard spots in the lab to the facility engineer, who nods.
shots.narration: 实验室负责人向施工方交代危险点。

shots.section_title: 实验室改造维修：审批与交底
shots.scene: 持证人员图标和证件图标
shots.prompt_en: A person icon with a certificate badge next to a scaffold and an electrical panel icon. No people.
shots.narration: 登高架设、电工作业，要持证上岗。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现危害、风险、事故、未遂四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside four floating icons: a warning triangle, a dice, a collision and a near-miss arrow.
shots.narration: 先分清危害、风险、事故和未遂。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔图标
shots.prompt_en: An inverted pyramid icon in five colors. No people.
shots.narration: 控制风险，从消除和替代先想。

shots.scene: 风险矩阵和表格图标
shots.prompt_en: A colored risk grid icon next to a blank table icon. No people.
shots.narration: 用矩阵定等级，用表格落实措施。

shots.scene: 护栏、梯子、安全带图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a guardrail, a ladder and a full-body harness. No people.
shots.narration: 高处作业有护栏、有防坠、有救援。

shots.scene: 围挡和审批单图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a construction fence and a blank approval form with a stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 施工区不擅入，改造维修先审批。

shots.scene: 欣欣摘下安全帽挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot takes off its hard hat and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 看得见风险，才能管得住风险，再见！
